title: in the Base overlays section, say which tests the brief's focused -run pattern covers, as separate commands without a pipe

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-184829-ca71, project ork, item S564:

in the Base overlays section, say which tests the brief's focused -run pattern covers, as separate commands without a pipe

Evidence: an unquoted `-run A|B` overlay command was denied as "multiple operations"; it had to be split into two calls
